annotation.title_clean: IEEE P7009.1 - IEEE Draft Standard for Safety Management of Autonomous and Semi-Autonomous Systems–Interventions in the Event of Anomalous Behavior
annotation.title_en: IEEE P7009.1 - IEEE Draft Standard for Safety Management of Autonomous and Semi-Autonomous Systems–Interventions in the Event of Anomalous Behavior
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE Reliability Society Standards Committee)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA catalogue page for draft standard P7009.1, defining capabilities for interventions when autonomous or semi-autonomous systems behave anomalously, within a Safety Management System. Also lists the related published IEEE 7009-2024 standard on fail-safe design.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines capabilities for interventions in the event of anomalous behavior of autonomous systems
Intended as an element of an operational Safety Management System
Aims to preserve freedom from unacceptable risk of harm
Related IEEE 7009-2024 sets fail-safe design baseline for autonomous systems
